messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty trigger -> level=P0, source=az2-serving, symptom=kv_fragmentation_evictions, ts=1767891234
pagerduty: Incident assigned -> SRE-P0-az2 -> oncall:sre-oncall
Priya Singh: acked and joining. pulling up dashboards now.
Maya Chen: I see a sudden spike in kv cache evictions on shard-group 9; eviction rate ~3.8k/min. dashboard: https://console.redwood/ops/d/az2-serv-eviction
Tom Rivera: also seeing CPU and memory climb on smaller hosts, looks like cache churn not kernel-level bug yet.
Alex Kim: no infra deploys in the last 3h from eng-runtime. tagging them @eng-runtime to confirm.
eng-runtime: confirmed — no kernel or runtime builds pushed to az2 in last 6h.
network-bot: NIC error counters elevated but below threshold; no full link flaps reported.
Priya Singh: starting mitigations: 1) add temporary cache reservation, 2) scale pool, 3) enable routing diversion for long-context jobs.
Tom Rivera: scaling plan: add +4 xlarge GPUs to az2-inference pool, initiating now.
Tom Rivera: ```rbctl pool resize --pool az2-inference-pool --add 4 --reason "eviction surge - emergency scale"```
Alex Kim: applying KV reserve feature flag for az2 to protect short requests.
Alex Kim: ```configctl set feature.kvcache.reserve.az2=0.12 --apply```
Maya Chen: enabling partial traffic diversion to az3 for model 'redwood-xlarge' at 25% so warm requests don't hit az2 hot paths.
Maya Chen: ```routerctl route set --model redwood-xlarge --fallback az3 --weight 0.25```
Priya Singh: running quick heap snapshot collection on worst nodes and lifting logs to S3 for correlation.
Priya Singh: `opsctl collect heap --nodes shard-9-{a,b,c} --out s3://redwood-ops/eviction-dumps/1767891234/`
Tom Rivera: restarting two worst-off nodes in shard-group 9 to drain fragmented caches and reclaim memory gracefully.
Tom Rivera: ```rbctl node restart --node shard-9-a --grace 90 && rbctl node restart --node shard-9-b --grace 90```
Support-bot: Created support ticket INC-7710 for customer communications (owner: Priya Singh).
Maya Chen: early customer-impact estimate: ~7% of routed inference traffic to EU saw latency >2x and ~3% saw 5xx. mostly long-context batched jobs.
Tom Rivera: eviction rate dropped ~60% after scale + restarts. tail latency falling but retry storms still generating transient 5xx.
Priya Singh: enabling short-term gateway retry-suppression for az2 to avoid amplifying load.
Priya Singh: ```edgectl retry-suppress --zone az2 --trigger 5xx --window 30s```
Alex Kim: kicking off kvcache-reclaim worker to defragment local cache shards.
Alex Kim: ```opsctl job run kv-defrag --zone az2 --target shard-9```
eng-runtime: recommended followups: run synthetic hit-rate load to validate cache behavior post-defrag.
Maya Chen: arranging customer outreach for top affected tenants — will coordinate with accounts. Support-bot linked INC-7710 to customer list.
Priya Singh: handoff plan: I'll take lead for the 2h post-incident triage and draft a postmortem. Maya, can you take external comms until handoff?
Maya Chen: taking external comms for first hour, then hand over to SRE-L2 for continuing remediation.
SRE-L2: standing by to accept handoff at +45m. will focus on root cause isolation and remediation (cache tuning, node sizing, potential tenant throttles).
incident-bot: PD note: acknowledged by Priya Singh at 1767891250
pagerduty: Escalation timer set: 15m
Tom Rivera: leaving a brief alert mute on eviction alarms for 8m while we stabilize to reduce noise.
Maya Chen: quick timeline so far: detection 0-2m, mitigations 2-12m (scale, reserve, restarts), stabilization 12-30m, continued reclamation and defrag 30-90m.
Priya Singh: current status: eviction metric trending down, gateway 5xx rate dropping, routing fallback active at 25%. continuing monitoring.
Tom Rivera: recommendation: keep fallback enabled at 25% for next 30m, then gradually reduce if eviction <100 evictions/min sustained for 15m.
Priya Singh: agreed. documenting actions in runbook pointer: https://wiki.redwood/runbooks/kv-eviction-handling
Support-bot: Added outreach checklist to INC-7710. assigned: Priya Singh, Maya Chen, Tom Rivera.
Maya Chen: leaving note: capture kernel vmstats, process RSS, and tenant request patterns for the 30m window around spike.
Priya Singh: will produce an impact note for customers and an initial RCA outline in #postmortems/az2-kvfragment-1767891234 by EOD.
incident-bot: condition cleared at 1767900050 -> PD: resolved
pagerduty: Incident SRE-P0-az2 status -> resolved; follow-up investigation required
Maya Chen: final checks: preserve heap dumps, config snapshots, and routing logs. we'll reconvene tomorrow for root cause deep dive. Closing this thread in 20m unless new alerts. :white_check_mark:
Tom Rivera: thanks team. good coordination. :thumbsup:
